name: Maturity Redemption Type 1 Code
definition: Indicates the type of redemption at maturity.

FRED.name: Final Redemption
FRED.definition: Indicates that the type of redemption at maturity is final.

PRNR.name: Partial Redemption Without Reduction
PRNR.definition: Indicates that the type of redemption at maturity is partial without reduction.

PRWR.name: Partial Redemption With Reduction
PRWR.definition: Indicates that the type of redemption at maturity is partial with reduction.

RNDM.name: Drawing At Random
RNDM.definition: Indicates that the type of redemption at maturity is drawing at random.

PRRA.name: Drawing Pro Rata
PRRA.definition: Indicates that the type of redemption at maturity is drawing pro-rata.

CALL.name: Call
CALL.definition: Indicates that the type of redemption at maturity is call.

PUUT.name: Put
PUUT.definition: Indicates that the type of redemption at maturity is put.
